hooks.command: tty=$(ps -eo tty,comm | awk '/zsh|bash|fish/ && /ttys/ {print "/dev/" $1; exit}'); [ -z "$tty" ] && exit 0; afplay /System/Library/Sounds/Frog.aiff & for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do printf '\a' > "$tty" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; done &
